title: potentilla nivea subsp. kuznetzowii
intro: Potentilla nivea subsp. kuznetzowii, commonly known as the Snowy Cinquefoil, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla nivea subsp. kuznetzowii involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
